# test-minimal.pdf
Source: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf
Retrieved: 2026-09-17
Copied byte-for-byte from the W3C WAI public test resource. WAI material is
covered by the W3C Document License as described at
https://www.w3.org/WAI/about/using-wai-material/ and
https://www.w3.org/copyright/document-license-2023/. Preserve the source URL,
copyright, and status notices when redistributing; this repository does not
modify the PDF bytes.
SHA-256: 3df79d34abbca99308e79cb94461c1893582604d68329a41fd4bec1885e6adb4
Size: 13264 bytes
Expected structure: one page; classic xref table; trailer /Root 14 0 R;
catalog /Pages 4 0 R; page-tree count 1.
Expected extracted text: "Dummy PDF file"
Independent validation (pypdf 6.8.0):
`python3 -c 'from pypdf import PdfReader; r=PdfReader("tests/fixtures/test-minimal.pdf"); assert len(r.pages)==1; assert r.pages[0].extract_text().strip()=="Dummy PDF file"'`
